seoTitle: Free JSON to JavaScript Object Literal Converter
metaDescription: Convert JSON to a JavaScript object literal with unquoted keys, single or double quotes and optional trailing commas. Free, runs offline.
intro: Turns JSON into code you can paste into a JavaScript file: keys that are valid identifiers lose their quotes, strings use your preferred quotes, and you can add a const declaration and trailing commas.
why:
JSON is valid JavaScript only by accident. In source code teams usually want unquoted keys, single quotes and a name for the value. Editing that by hand is dull and quotes inside strings are easy to break.

The tool parses your JSON, so invalid input is reported instead of guessed at, and it escapes strings for the quote style you pick. A key named __proto__ is written as a computed key so that it stays a normal property.
howTo: Pick the quote style and indent.
Set a variable name, or clear it for a bare literal.

faq.a: Keys that are not valid identifiers, such as first-name or 1abc.
JSON.parse turns them into Infinity. The output keeps what JavaScript read.
No. JSON numbers become JavaScript numbers, so integers over 2^53 lose precision.

faq.q: Does it support comments or trailing commas in the input?
faq.a: No, the input must be strict JSON.
